card.name: Numbers in dose tables
card.fires_on: Digits and the gap just before a number in dosing text, such as the start of a dose value, a range, or a threshold. It also fires on 'thousand' after a number.

modes.label: Start of a dose number
modes.description: The first digit or the space before a dose or lab value in a dosing sentence or table.

modes.label: Space before a value in a table
modes.description: A blank gap right before a number in a table cell or threshold.

modes.label: Inside a number or dosing word
modes.description: Partway through a number or a dosing word.

card.plain: It marks the spot just before or inside a dose number in dosing text.
